correctness.rationale: For every fixed finite named vertex set and every valuation, Lemma 1 proves exactly which neighbourhood homogeneity predicates coincide, including 0/1 degree boundaries. The one-letter Δp observation is precisely that predicate; the inductive preservation of all modal depths is valid. Symmetry and irreflexivity force any undetectable edge to be a whole K2 component, proving an exact two-sided kernel theorem. Matching lifts are bijective, and the bivariate exponential generating function correctly excludes isolated vertices and K2 components in the nonisolated core. End cases n=1 and 2 and formal-series conventions are explicit. Executed checker.py exhaustively checks n=1,...,6 and yielded ALL_CHECKS_OK 66771; all-size conclusion rests on symbolic proof.

value.rationale: The object is the natural class of finite labelled undirected loop-free accessibility graphs and the intrinsic observational indistinguishability relation induced by non-contingency under all valuations. The result supplies a complete canonical semantic quotient, sharply minimal distinguishing modal depth one, a linear-time kernel algorithm, exact class-fiber sizes and the complete distribution of redundant frame presentations. It determines which edges this epistemic/contingency operator can never detect, even with all formulas. This is not a single arbitrary parameter slice or a bare known counting table. The univariate known count is properly credited rather than used as independent value evidence.
